influences.name: Joseph (Amp) Fiddler
influences.context: He apprenticed with Joseph (Amp) Fiddler, a legendary local funk musician who inspired him to master the art of sampling.

influences.name: East Coast hip-hop (nineteen-nineties)
influences.context: While Yancey was influenced by the resounding symmetry of nineteen-nineties East Coast hip-hop, everything he produced sounded a little off.

influences.name: Q-Tip
influences.context: But in the mid-nineties, at the behest of Fiddler, the m.c. Q-Tip, of A Tribe Called Quest, became a mentor to Yancey.
